फुल्ति, इस्, f. full expansion or perfection (?); see
Vopa-deva

फुल्ल, अस्, आ, अम् (past pass. part. of rt. फल्
by Pāṇ.

), ‘split or cleft open,’ open,
expanded, blown (as a flower); in full bloom,
flowering, flowery, in blossom, covered with flowers;
opened wide, dilated (as the eyes); smiling, gay;
(अस्), m., N. of a saint; (अम्), n. a full-blown
flower; [cf. Gr. φύλλο-ν; Lat. foliu-m.]
—फुल्ल-
तुवरी, f. alum.
—फुल्ल-दामन्, अ, n. ‘flowery
garland,’ a kind of metre, four times ¯¯¯¯¯,
˘˘˘˘˘˘¯, ¯˘¯¯˘¯¯, (also called पुष्प-
दामन्, q. v.)
—फुल्ल-दृष्टि, इस्, इस्, इ, or फुल्ल-
नयन, or फुल्ल-नेत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having full
or large eyes, having the eyes dilated (with pleasure),
smiling, happy.
—फुल्ल-पुर, अम्, n., N. of a
city.
—फुल्ल-फाल, अस्, m. the wind raised in
winnowing corn (= फल्ल-फल).
—फुल्ल-लो-
चन, अस्, आ, अम्, having the eyes dilated, looking
pleased or happy; full-eyed; (अस्), m. a kind of
antelope; (अम्), n. a large full eye.
—फुल्ल-वत्,
आन्, अती, अत्, expanded, blossoming, blowing.
—फुल्-
ल-वदन, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘smiling-faced,’ looking
pleased or happy.
—फुल्लाम्बिका (˚ल-अम्˚), f., N.
of a woman, wife of Go-vinda and mother of Nīla-
kaṇṭha Catur-dhara.
—फुल्लारण्य-माहात्म्य
[]
(˚ल-अर्˚), अम्, n., N. of a section of the Agni-
Purāṇa.
—फुल्लोत्पल (˚ल-उत्˚), अम्, n. ‘whose
lotuses are in full bloom,’ N. of a lake.
फुल्ल फुल्ल, फुल्ति, &c. See p. 670, col. 1.

फुलिङ्ग फुलिङ्ग, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?),
syphilis; [cf. फिरङ्ग.]

फुल्ल् फुल्ल् (more properly regarded as
a Nom. fr. फुल्ल), cl. 1. P. फुल्लति,
पुफुल्ल, &c., to open, expand (as a flower),
bloom, blossom, blow, flower.
फुल्लन, अस्, ई, अम्, filling with air, inflating.

फुल्लरीक फुल्लरीक, अस्, m. a district, place;
a snake, serpent.
